config_file.description: The path of the configuration file the writer read.

config_digest.description: `sha256:` and the SHA-256 of that file's bytes, which is what sha256sum prints for it: the configuration this writer ran under.

deployment_digest.description: The digest of the profile document the configuration names, which decides what each profile keeps.

workloads_digest.description: The digest of the workloads document, when the configuration names one.

catalogues_digest.description: The digest of the directory of catalogues the configuration names: of each file's name and digest, in name order.

layer.description: On Lambda, the ARN of the immutable layer version that carried the configuration, as the deployment declared it to the function.

function_version.description: On Lambda, the function version the platform reports (AWS_LAMBDA_FUNCTION_VERSION).
